description: Leah is coordinating a Wednesday outing for their grandmother's pharmacy and post-office errands and must make the final call about the day, driver, start time, and accessibility plan after checking in with her sibling and cousin.

shared_context.S1: Their grandmother needs one outing to pick up a prescription and mail a package.
shared_context.S2: Leah is coordinating the outing and will make the final plan.
shared_context.S3: The pharmacy and post office are in the same shopping area, and the family car has four seats.
shared_context.S4: At their regular Sunday family call, Leah goes around the group and asks what needs to be considered before she finalizes plans.
shared_context.S5: The outing should be completed in one visit rather than split across separate days.

PF1.text: Daniel can drive and accompany their grandmother only on Wednesday from 09:30 to 12:00 because of his work schedule; he has not yet told Leah.

PF2.text: Priya spoke with their grandmother's occupational therapist, who recommended limiting her standing and walking to exactly 45 minutes and using pharmacy curbside pickup rather than having her wait inside; this has not reached the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: The outing must take place on Wednesday.
Daniel must drive and the outing must begin at 09:30.
The prescription must be collected using pharmacy curbside pickup.
The plan must set the grandmother's maximum standing and walking time at exactly 45 minutes.
A commitment confirming Daniel as the driver must exist.
A commitment covering the curbside and 45-minute accessibility plan must exist.
Priya's occupational-therapist information must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: Daniel's exact Wednesday 09:30-12:00 availability changes the outing day to Wednesday, fixes the start time at 09:30, makes A2 the driver, and enables the driver-confirmation commitment.
The occupational therapist's recommendation changes the pharmacy method to curbside pickup, sets the walking limit at exactly 45 minutes, and requires the accessibility-plan commitment and citation.
